name: Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Help at a library branch with events, crafts and everyday tasks, and earn service hours.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 12 to 18. Everyone must pass the City background screening, which may include fingerprints. The page says there are more applicants than openings.
deadline_text: The page lists no deadline. It says the library gets more applicants than openings.
how_to_apply: Look at the openings on the volunteer page. Apply online. Staff will email you the next steps.
notes: Not everyone who applies is picked. Group volunteering: JPLVolunteers@coj.net. Teen specific openings are listed on a teen page that was not read.
